rem.title: iPhone reminders (no app needed)
rem.intro: Your iPhone can tap you on the shoulder using its own Shortcuts and Calendar apps: a notification when you arrive at a place, a morning or Sunday summary, and your house tasks in the calendar. Step by step: docs/REMINDERS.md.

rem.warning: Anyone with these links can read your to-dos and house tasks (not change them). Revoke the key if a link leaks.

recap.title: This week
tour.title: Welcome. Let's get you started
tour.1.title: Write down one thing
tour.1.body: What is one thing you keep meaning to do? Write it once, and stop carrying it in your head.
tour.2.title: Where do you shop?
tour.2.body: Pick the kinds of shops you visit. A to-do can then wait for the right shop.
tour.3.title: Put it on your home screen
tour.3.body: Add Home Memory to your home screen so it opens like an app, and turn on notifications so you hear when your partner adds something.
tour.ios: On iPhone: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Get a notification on this device when your partner adds a to-do, and when a to-do with a time is due.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then try again.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone, notifications only work once Home Memory is on your home screen: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", and open it from there.
push.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up yet (see docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md).

a11y.contrastHelp: Stronger text and borders, and solid bars instead of glass.

rem.steps.title: Set up "when I arrive" in 4 steps
rem.steps.1: Open the Shortcuts app, tap Automation, then +, then Arrive.
rem.steps.2: Choose the place, and set it to Run Immediately.
rem.steps.3: Add the action "Get Contents of URL" and paste that place's link from the list below.
rem.steps.4: Add "If" (has any value), then "Show Notification" with the result. Done: you now get the list when you arrive.
arrive.title: When I arrive
arrive.intro: One automation per place. Copy the link, then follow the steps.
arrive.noPlaces: Add a place first (Places tab), then it appears here.

acct.title: Your account
acct.deleteIntro: Delete your account and what is stored about you. If you are alone in the household, all its to-dos, places, facts, photos and tasks are deleted. If a partner shares it, their data stays and your to-dos go to them. This cannot be undone.
